# thefblas

> thefblas is a header-only C++17 BLAS-style library implementing the Level 1, 2 and 3 BLAS routines as templates over the element type: `float`, `double`, the generic Q-format fixed-point type `thefblas::fixed<IntType, FracBits, Policy>`, and `std::complex` of any of them. It targets embedded use (including bare-metal ARM Cortex-M without an FPU) and needs nothing beyond the C++ standard library.

Instead of the `s`/`d`/`c`/`z` precision-prefixed functions of Netlib BLAS, each routine is one template (`thefblas::gemm`, `thefblas::dot`, ...) with Netlib argument order and semantics: column-major storage, `incx`/`incy` strides (including negative), and the Netlib rules for quick returns and for not reading `A`/`B` when `alpha == 0` or `C`/`y` when `beta == 0`. `iamax` returns a 1-based index.

For fixed point, overflow is resolved by a compile-time policy (`checked`, the default, asserts in debug builds; `wrap`; `saturate`), and internal reductions are accumulated exactly in an integer twice as wide as the element, with products at twice the fractional bits, so each output element is rounded and narrowed once. Floating-point Level 1 and Level 2 results stay bit-identical to the straightforward Netlib loops (except `nrm2`, which uses Blue's scaled algorithm as Netlib 3.10+ does). Every public routine is `noexcept`.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Overview, design, the `fixed` type and its overflow policies, wide accumulators and their limits, the full list of routines, build and test instructions, CMake options and presets, cross-compilation, static analysis, packaging and Doxygen
- [docs/math-reference.md](docs/math-reference.md): Mathematical definition of every routine, with the fixed-point rounding and overflow behaviour where it differs from floating point
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Version history in Keep a Changelog format
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines, code style, how to write tests with the in-repo test helper, and the pull request process

- [SECURITY](SECURITY.md): Security policy and vulnerability reporting
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): Index of the Copilot agents and reusable skills under `.github/`

## Public API (header-only, `include/thefblas/`)

- [thefblas.h](include/thefblas/thefblas.h): Umbrella header that includes everything below
- [fixed.hpp](include/thefblas/fixed.hpp): `fixed<IntType, FracBits, Policy>` (arithmetic rounding to nearest, ties away from zero; `constexpr` `sqrt`; `fixed_cast` between Q formats), the `std::numeric_limits` specialisation, and the aliases `q7`, `q15`, `q31`, `q16_16` and their `_sat` variants
- [overflow.hpp](include/thefblas/overflow.hpp): The overflow policies `checked`, `wrap` and `saturate`
- [level1.hpp](include/thefblas/level1.hpp): `swap`, `copy`, `axpy`, `scal`, `dot`, `dotu`, `dotc`, `sdsdot`, `dsdot`, `nrm2`, `asum`, `iamax`, `rot`, `rotg`, `rotm`, `rotmg`, plus overloads of `copy`, `axpy`, `scal`, the dot products, `nrm2`, `asum`, `iamax`, `rot` and `rotm` taking contiguous ranges (anything with `std::data` and `std::size`: arrays, `std::vector`, `std::array`, `std::span`, ...)
- [level2.hpp](include/thefblas/level2.hpp): Dense `gemv`, `ger`, `geru`, `gerc`, `symv`, `hemv`, `syr`, `her`, `syr2`, `her2`, `trmv`, `trsv`
- [level2_banded.hpp](include/thefblas/level2_banded.hpp): Banded `gbmv`, `sbmv`, `hbmv`, `tbmv`, `tbsv`
- [level2_packed.hpp](include/thefblas/level2_packed.hpp): Packed `spmv`, `hpmv`, `tpmv`, `tpsv`, `spr`, `hpr`, `spr2`, `hpr2`
- [level3.hpp](include/thefblas/level3.hpp): `gemm`, `symm`, `hemm`, `syrk`, `herk`, `syr2k`, `her2k`, `trmm`, `trsm`
- [detail.hpp](include/thefblas/detail.hpp): Internal helpers: the widened accumulators (`real_mac`, `complex_mac`), the exact sum of squares behind `nrm2`/`rotg`, and the per-element scaling and narrowing shared by Level 2 and Level 3

## Tests

- [tests/test_support.hpp](tests/test_support.hpp): In-repo test helper (`CHECK`, `CHECK_EQ`, `CHECK_PRED`, `CHECK_VALUES`, `CHECK_MSG`, `TEST_CONTEXT`); a failed check prints its expression, values and context and the test carries on
- [tests/test_support_selftest.cpp](tests/test_support_selftest.cpp): Tests of the helper itself
- [tests/test_fixed.cpp](tests/test_fixed.cpp): The `fixed` type: arithmetic, rounding, conversions, overflow policies, `numeric_limits`
- [tests/test_checked_release.cpp](tests/test_checked_release.cpp): The `checked` policy with `NDEBUG` (no assertions, well-defined results)
- [tests/test_accumulators.cpp](tests/test_accumulators.cpp): Wide-accumulator behaviour: exact sums, cancellation, accumulator overflow, edge formats such as `q15`
- [tests/test_level1.cpp](tests/test_level1.cpp), [tests/test_level2.cpp](tests/test_level2.cpp), [tests/test_level2_banded.cpp](tests/test_level2_banded.cpp), [tests/test_level2_packed.cpp](tests/test_level2_packed.cpp), [tests/test_level3.cpp](tests/test_level3.cpp): Routine tests for float, double, fixed point and complex
- [tests/test_widths.cpp](tests/test_widths.cpp): Every routine on 8-bit and 64-bit fixed-point storage, real and complex, compared with the same routine in `double` within each routine's rounding bound (`THEFBLAS_TEST_SEED` selects other inputs)
- [tests/test_api.cpp](tests/test_api.cpp): `noexcept` on every public routine, the range overloads, and constant evaluation of `fixed` `sqrt`
- [tests/test_coverage_edges.cpp](tests/test_coverage_edges.cpp): Edge cases that keep line and function coverage at 100%
- [tests/test_reference_blas.cpp](tests/test_reference_blas.cpp): Opt-in randomised comparison of the floating-point and complex routines with a system CBLAS (`THEFBLAS_ENABLE_REFERENCE_TESTS`)

## Examples

- [examples/fixed_point_ops.cpp](examples/fixed_point_ops.cpp): Level 1 (`axpy`, `dot`, `nrm2`, `asum`, `iamax`) and Level 2 (`gemv`, `gbmv`, `spmv`, `tpsv`) routines on a Q11.20 `fixed` type

## Build and Configuration

- [CMakeLists.txt](CMakeLists.txt): `INTERFACE` library target `thefblas::thefblas`, install and export rules, and the options `THEFBLAS_BUILD_TESTS`, `THEFBLAS_BUILD_EXAMPLES`, `THEFBLAS_ENABLE_STRICT_WARNINGS`, `THEFBLAS_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS`, `THEFBLAS_ENABLE_SANITIZERS`, `THEFBLAS_ENABLE_COVERAGE`, `THEFBLAS_ENABLE_IPO`, `THEFBLAS_ENABLE_REFERENCE_TESTS`, `THEFBLAS_ENABLE_RELEASE_HARDENING`; warning, sanitizer and coverage flags apply only to the project's own tests and examples
- [CMakePresets.json](CMakePresets.json): Presets `gcc-debug`, `gcc-release`, `gcc-debug-sanitized`, `gcc-debug-coverage`, `clang-debug`, `clang-debug-sanitized`, `clang-release`, `msvc-release`, `arm-linux-debug`, `arm-linux-release`, `arm-none-eabi-debug`, `arm-none-eabi-release`
- [cmake/thefblasConfig.cmake.in](cmake/thefblasConfig.cmake.in): Package config template for `find_package(thefblas)`
- [tests/CMakeLists.txt](tests/CMakeLists.txt): One CTest executable per test file
- [examples/CMakeLists.txt](examples/CMakeLists.txt): The `thefblas_example_fixed_point_ops` target
- [Makefile](Makefile): Wrapper with `configure`, `build`, `test`, `install`, `docs`, `coverage`, `clean` and `rebuild` targets

## Toolchains

- [cmake/toolchains/clang.cmake](cmake/toolchains/clang.cmake): Clang/LLVM
- [cmake/toolchains/msvc.cmake](cmake/toolchains/msvc.cmake): MSVC on Windows
- [cmake/toolchains/arm-linux-gnueabihf.cmake](cmake/toolchains/arm-linux-gnueabihf.cmake): 32-bit ARM Linux, hard float (tests run under qemu-user)
- [cmake/toolchains/arm-none-eabi.cmake](cmake/toolchains/arm-none-eabi.cmake): Bare-metal ARM Cortex-M (`THEFBLAS_ARM_MCU`, `THEFBLAS_ARM_FLOAT_ABI`, `THEFBLAS_ARM_FPU`)

## Package Management

- [conanfile.py](conanfile.py): Conan 2.x recipe for a header-only package with the `thefblas::thefblas` target
- [test_package/](test_package/conanfile.py): Conan test package that builds and runs a small consumer
- [ports/thefblas/](ports/thefblas/portfile.cmake): vcpkg port (`vcpkg_from_github` on the release tarball)
- [versions/baseline.json](versions/baseline.json), [versions/t-/thefblas.json](versions/t-/thefblas.json): vcpkg versions database, so the repository can be used as a vcpkg git registry; updated by `scripts/update-vcpkg-port.py` after each release

## Release Automation

- [scripts/prepare-release.py](scripts/prepare-release.py): Sets the version and moves `[Unreleased]` into a versioned changelog section; run in the release pull request
- [scripts/extract-changelog.py](scripts/extract-changelog.py): Prints a changelog section, used as the release notes
- [scripts/update-vcpkg-port.py](scripts/update-vcpkg-port.py): Points the vcpkg port and versions database at a published release tag

## Static Analysis and Code Quality

- [.clang-tidy](.clang-tidy): clang-tidy checks; compiler diagnostics are errors, and warnings are reported for the library headers
- [.clang-format](.clang-format): Formatting style
- [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml): Pre-commit hooks (whitespace and file checks, codespell, cmake-format/cmake-lint, clang-format, clang-tidy, conventional commits, markdownlint)
- [.codespellrc](.codespellrc), [.markdownlint-cli2.yaml](.markdownlint-cli2.yaml), [.editorconfig](.editorconfig): Spelling, Markdown and editor settings

## CI/CD Workflows

- [build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Static analysis (cppcheck, clang-tidy, Clang Static Analyzer); GCC/Clang/AppleClang × Debug/Release tests; GCC and Clang sanitizer jobs; arm-linux-gnueabihf tests under qemu; arm-none-eabi Cortex-M0/M4/M4F compile and link; Doxygen
- [coverage.yml](.github/workflows/coverage.yml): Coverage report; fails below 100% line or function coverage
- [msvc.yml](.github/workflows/msvc.yml): Microsoft C++ Code Analysis (PREfast) of the MSVC build
- [codeql.yml](.github/workflows/codeql.yml): CodeQL security analysis for C++
- [grype.yml](.github/workflows/grype.yml), [sbom.yml](.github/workflows/sbom.yml): SBOM generation and vulnerability scanning
- [conan-test.yml](.github/workflows/conan-test.yml), [vcpkg-test.yml](.github/workflows/vcpkg-test.yml): Package-manager integration tests on Ubuntu and macOS (the vcpkg test uses this repository as a git registry)
- [docs.yml](.github/workflows/docs.yml): GitHub Pages site with the Doxygen API reference and the math reference rendered by pandoc and MathJax
- [release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): When the version in CMakeLists.txt has no tag yet and CHANGELOG.md has a section for it, tags the commit and creates the GitHub Release from that section; never pushes to `main`
- [claude.yml](.github/workflows/claude.yml), [claude-code-review.yml](.github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml), [copilot-setup-steps.yml](.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml): AI assistant automation
- [greetings.yml](.github/workflows/greetings.yml), [stale.yml](.github/workflows/stale.yml), [summary.yml](.github/workflows/summary.yml): Repository housekeeping
